description.value:
Nothing excites you more than pushing at the edge of what's known. You've spent far more hours in a lab than most people spend on any single pursuit in their lives, chasing a research question that few others could even follow, let alone answer.

Whether you left your field voluntarily or were shown the door, your training still shapes how you see every problem: as something that can be understood, if you just have enough data and enough time.

system.equipment: A set of common clothes, a datapad, a book on your field of research, and a pouch containing 100 credits.
